title: Apollo Pricing in 2026: Plans, Credits and Dialer Add-On Costs
summary: Apollo is $49 to $119 per seat a month billed annually, or $65 and $99 monthly. Calls use credits; power and parallel dialing add $119 or $149 per team.
body_markdown:
Apollo publishes its prices. Basic is $49 per seat per month billed annually or $65 billed monthly. Professional is $79 or $99. Organization is $119 billed annually with a three-seat minimum. There is a free plan. Calls on paid plans use credits, at 1 credit per 30 seconds for US calls. Power and parallel dialing need the Advanced Dialer add-on, at $119 per team per month billed annually or $149 billed monthly. Read on November 17, 2026.


Trellus publishes this guide and sells a dialer that competes with Apollo's and also works inside Apollo. Every Apollo detail below comes from Apollo's own pricing page, dialer page, terms and knowledge base, opened on November 17, 2026. No price here comes from a review site, and no paid Apollo account or trial was used. For how the two dialers compare, see[how Apollo dialing works](https://www.trellus.ai/post/apollo-dialer) and[how to make calls from Apollo](https://www.trellus.ai/post/how-to-make-calls-from-apollo) .

## What changes the real cost of Apollo


The seat price is only part of an Apollo bill for a calling team. Credits, the dialer add-on and the billing term all move the total.


### Credits pay for data and for calls


Apollo uses one pool of credits. The pricing page lists 1 credit for an email, 8 credits for a phone number, 1 to 8 credits to enrich data and 1 credit per AI research run. The US Dialer costs 1 credit per 30 seconds. The International Dialer rate varies by region.


Apollo's[Dialer Overview](https://knowledge.apollo.io/hc/en-us/articles/4409140527757-Dialer-Overview) says credits are used only when a call connects to a person, a voicemail or an answering machine. There is a 30-second minimum, and longer calls round up to the next 30 seconds. Calls that ring out, are busy, fail or are cancelled use no credits.


At that rate a three-minute connected US call uses 6 credits. A Basic seat's 30,000 annual credits would cover 15,000 connected minutes if nothing else used them, but phone numbers at 8 credits each draw from the same pool.


Credits are pooled across the team. They reset each billing cycle and do not roll over. Extra credits are bought in the app, as Apollo's[plan management article](https://knowledge.apollo.io/hc/en-us/articles/4677130104333-Customize-and-Manage-Your-Apollo-Plan) describes. They are charged at once and renew each cycle until removed. Their price is not published on the pricing page.


### The Advanced Dialer add-on


The dialer included in paid plans makes single calls. Apollo's[parallel and power dialing article](https://knowledge.apollo.io/hc/en-us/articles/45479798484621-Use-Parallel-or-Power-Dialing-to-Reach-Prospects-Faster) says both modes require the Advanced Dialer add-on. Parallel dialing allows up to five calls at once, and Apollo recommends three. It works on saved contacts only.


The add-on is sold per team, not per seat. The pricing page calls it introductory pricing that may change. Apollo's pages do not say that the add-on changes the credit charge for connected calls.


As an example, five Professional seats on annual billing are $395 a month. With the add-on at $119, the total is $514, or $102.80 per rep. The same team on monthly billing pays $495 plus $149, or $644. One rep on annual billing pays $79 plus $119, or $198 a month.


### Phone numbers


Apollo's[phone number article](https://knowledge.apollo.io/hc/en-us/articles/26604621629069-Get-an-Apollo-Phone-Number) says each user on a plan with the dialer gets one free active number. More numbers are bought with monthly credits. The cap is one number on Basic, five on Professional and ten on Custom. The credit cost of an extra number is not stated there. International numbers and local presence need the add-on.


### Annual or monthly billing


Monthly billing costs more per seat: $65 against $49 on Basic and $99 against $79 on Professional. Annual billing is paid upfront for 12 months. The pricing page says an annual plan cannot be downgraded mid-cycle. Downgrades give no refund for unused time, and cancellations take effect at the end of the plan term.


Apollo's[terms](https://www.apollo.io/terms) , last updated August 10, 2026, say subscriptions renew automatically. Notice of non-renewal is due at least 30 days before the term ends. Fees are non-cancelable and non-refundable.


### Trial limits


Basic and Professional have a 14-day trial with 75 credits. Apollo's[trial article](https://knowledge.apollo.io/hc/en-us/articles/5288168088205-Access-a-Free-Trial-of-Apollo) caps trial calls at 60 minutes in total and phone number reveals at 20. It says the dialer is in a Professional trial but not a Basic trial.


## Who Apollo fits and who it does not


Apollo sells contact data, email sequences, a dialer and deal tools in one product. Its pricing FAQ places Free with founders and light users, Basic with individual sellers doing regular outbound, and Professional with full-time reps who need more credits and call recording.


It fits a team that wants data, sequences and calling in one subscription. The dialer page also aims at teams that want to replace a separate dialer.


Apollo is a weaker fit for a team that only wants a dialer on top of another CRM. That team pays for a seat plan and the add-on, and parallel dialing runs on contacts saved in Apollo. Heavy calling is also harder to budget, because calls and data share one credit pool. Plan levels cannot be mixed on one account.

## Frequently asked questions


### How much does Apollo cost per user?


Apollo's pricing page lists Basic at $49 per seat per month billed annually or $65 billed monthly, and Professional at $79 or $99. Organization is $119 billed annually with a minimum of three seats. There is a free plan with 75 credits per seat a month. Custom plans have no published price.


### Is the dialer included in Apollo plans?


Apollo's pricing page lists a US Dialer on Basic, Professional and Organization, with credits applying. It is not listed on the Free plan. Connected US calls cost 1 credit per 30 seconds. Power dialing, parallel dialing, international dialing and local presence need the Advanced Dialer add-on.


### How much does the Apollo parallel dialer cost?


Parallel dialing is part of the Advanced Dialer add-on. Apollo lists it at $119 per team per month billed annually, or $149 billed monthly, on top of a paid plan. Apollo calls this introductory pricing that may change.


### How do Apollo credits work?


Credits pay for emails, phone numbers, enrichment, AI research and connected calls. An email is 1 credit and a phone number is 8. Credits are pooled across the team, reset each billing cycle and do not roll over. More can be bought in the app, and they renew until removed.


### Does Apollo have a free trial?


Yes. Basic and Professional have a 14-day trial with 75 credits. Trial calls are capped at 60 minutes in total, and the dialer is available in a Professional trial only. Organization has no trial. When a trial ends, the account can move to the free plan.
